race.comment: GLADIATRIX (10) hasn't raced since the Vicbred Super Series Final at Melton in September but she goes very well at this circuit and distance, winning five of eight tries. Came from this barrier to take out the NSW Oaks earlier the year. She can add to a good fresh record. PRINCE KENNY (2) put it together at his latest appearance when he scored by 2 metres at this circuit and distance. A nice draw should ensure a cosy run. Could be ready to go on with it. TUNBRIDGE (3) has joined Leon Jurd since last seen at Albion Park. Draws well and has won at this circuit and distance before. CASUALCONNECTION (7) can feature with her A-game.
